title: Bills GM Brandon Beane jokes about Carnell Tate's 40-yard dash time

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bills GM Brandon Beane jokes about Carnell Tate's 40-yard dash time
sources.description: Carnell Tate ran the 40-yard dash in 4.53 seconds and Bills GM Brandon Beane joked the top NFL draft prospect should fall – perhaps to Buffalo's pick.
